text.description_html:
Laurey 74626, Aventura Polished Chrome Cabinet Pull

The Small Polished Chrome Aventura Cabinet Pull is made out of zinc. This cabinet handle is a great choice for any home remodel project. The Polished Chrome finish is stunning. The Aventura Polished Chrome Cabinet Pull comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Aventura Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 74626 96mm Pull Aventura Polished Chrome:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Polished Chrome
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3-3/4" (96mm)
  • Overall Length: 4"
  • Width: 1/2"
  • Projection: 7/8"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
